# Fudumala School Jersey Drive

> A community campaign that sponsors warm school jerseys for learners in Tembisa, South Africa through the Ubuntu Challenge.

The Fudumala School Jersey Drive is run by the Threads for Ikasi Foundation. One school jersey costs R350. Sponsors give, share the campaign on social media, tag three people, and encourage them to pass the warmth forward. This is called the Ubuntu Challenge.

The campaign has been running since 2023. In 2024, 570 jerseys were sponsored across 12 schools through a partnership with Sandvik. In 2025, 262 learners were reached and the campaign expanded to the Eastern Cape. The 2026 goal is 1,000 jerseys.

Jerseys are manufactured by ZS Uniforms and delivered to learners through 15 participating schools across Tembisa, Gauteng, South Africa.

- [Schools](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/schools/): The 15 schools in Tembisa that receive sponsored jerseys
- [Impact 2025](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/impact/2025/): Results and stories from the 2025 season
- [Impact 2024](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/impact/2024/): Results and stories from the 2024 season
- [Impact 2023](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/impact/2023/): Results and stories from the 2023 season
- [News](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/news/): Press coverage and campaign updates
- [About](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/about/): Background on the campaign and Threads for Ikasi Foundation
- [FAQ](https://fudumala.threadsforikasi.org/faq/): Frequently asked questions about the campaign

## Sponsorship tiers

- Ubuntu Sponsor: R350 for 1 jersey
- Triple Ubuntu: R1,000 for 3 jerseys
- Class Hero: R3,500 for 10 jerseys
- School Champion: R10,000 for 30 jerseys
- Contributions from R100 are also accepted through the partial contribution engine

## Organisation

- Campaign: Fudumala School Jersey Drive
- Parent organisation: Threads for Ikasi Foundation (https://threadsforikasi.org)
- Jersey manufacturer: ZS Uniforms (https://zsuniforms.co.za)
- Area served: Tembisa, Gauteng, South Africa (with expansion to Eastern Cape)
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/threadsforikasi | https://www.instagram.com/threadsforikasi/ | https://www.youtube.com/@ThreadsForikasiFoundation
